name: tool_v_transpile
rationale: Programmatic counterpart to gui_v_transpile_html. Lets tools (and the synthesizer) request multi-language output without spawning a browser. Many-to-many via a shared IR keeps the matrix at O(sources + targets) instead of O(sources * targets) emitters.
statement: CLI any-source-to-any-target transpiler. Sources: python, c, cpp, rust, javascript, typescript, go. Targets: anything V_Framework's vendored/V_Framework/lib/transpilers/ provides (c, cpp, go, html, javascript, rust today). Architecture: parses source via cards/tool/v_transpile/frontends/<lang>.py into a minimal JSON IR, emits Python from the IR, then chains to python_to_<target>. PV1 extends the IR with try/with/class/async/await/decorator/comprehension/lambda/generator/fstring/walrus — see state/v_transpile_coverage.json (89.7% AST coverage).
substrate_role: substrate machinery; ingest, observe, emit, validate
